name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: The dumbbell Romanian deadlift trains the hamstrings and glutes in the same hip-hinge pattern as the barbell version but with independent dumbbells that allow each limb to move freely. The dumbbells can be held in front of the thighs or to the sides, and the movement is a good introduction to the hip-hinge pattern before progressing to a barbell.

execution.starting_position: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs. Spine neutral, chest up.
execution.setup_instructions: Hold the dumbbells with palms facing the thighs. Engage lats and brace before each rep.
steps: Push the hips backward while maintaining a slight knee bend.
Lower the dumbbells along the front of the legs, keeping the spine neutral.
Descend until a hamstring stretch is felt, then drive the hips forward to return to standing.
execution.breathing_instructions: Inhale on descent, exhale on the hip drive upward.
safety_considerations: Focus on the hip hinge pattern before adding significant load
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Lower until a hamstring stretch is felt — typically around knee to mid-shin level.
coaching_cues: Push your hips back as if closing a car door with your glutes
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs — drag them down the thighs
